title: Power Apps: modernised Personal settings experience in model-driven apps
summary: The briefing passes: its rollout facts match the roadmap, and Microsoft Learn supports the user path, default experience and temporary classic fallback. It distinguishes the preview Appearance settings from the wider redesign and appropriately leaves feature-specific licensing and administrator controls unconfirmed.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes a presentation and navigation change without describing new data access.
claims.quote: The Personal settings experience in model-driven apps has been modernized with clearer organization, updated navigation, and a more consistent design.

claims.claim: Neither the roadmap nor the Personal settings documentation describes a new autonomous capability for this redesign.
claims.quote: Searched: "Power Apps" "modern Personal settings" "autonomous". Opened: set-personal-options in full; read the roadmap description. Existing email tracking options are documented, not a new autonomous capability of the redesign.

claims.claim: Microsoft documents no administrator UI or automation switch for the modern Personal settings panel.
claims.quote: Searched: "modern Personal settings" "API" "disable"; "personal settings" modern Dataverse Web API Organization Power Platform API pac admin PowerShell enable disable. Opened: set-personal-options; modern-fluent-design; read admin settings and pac admin excerpts.

claims.claim: The preview Appearance settings article documents display density defaults.
claims.quote: The default value for the Display density setting is Comfortable.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not published a removal date for the classic Personal settings experience.
claims.quote: Searched: "Set Personal Options" classic removal date deprecated modern. Opened: set-personal-options. The feature page says only "will be removed in a future release"; results for other classic experiences do not establish this dialog's removal date.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated whether administrators can hide this panel's Switch to classic button.
claims.quote: Searched: "personal settings" "modern" "Power Apps" admin disable hide "Switch to classic". Opened: set-personal-options; modern-fluent-design. The behavior-settings search excerpt concerns classic app, view and form designers, not this panel.
